title.english: An Old Shoe on the Lectern

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ yìzhī jiù xié gē shàng jiǎngtái , xiédǐ cháozhe tāmen . qiánpái de rén xiān wǎnghòu duǒ , wéndào de què zhǐyǒu gān pígé de qìwèi . xiédǐ bǔguò liǎnghuí , wàiyán xié mó qù yì jié , dīngtóu liàng dé xiàng jǐlì xiǎo yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey set an old shoe on the lectern, sole toward them. The front row drew back, but smelled only dry leather. The sole had been patched twice, its outer edge worn slantwise, nail heads shining like little eyes.
pairs.hanzi:
维老师把一只旧鞋搁上讲台，鞋底朝着他们。
前排的人先往后躲，闻到的却只有干皮革的气味。鞋底补过两回，外沿斜磨去一截，钉头亮得像几粒小眼睛。

pairs.target: " zhè búshì ràng nǐmen jiàndìng cáiliào . " tā shuō , " shàng yíjiè gēn gǎng de xuéshēng chuān huílái de . líkāi shíshuō xié gòu jiēshi , huílái shíshuō lù tài duō . " pà wò dītóu kàn zìjǐ de xié , dé mǎ yǐjīng xiào le .
pairs.english: “This isn't a material-identification exercise,” she said. “A student wore it back from the last placement cohort. Leaving, he said his shoes were sturdy enough. Returning, he said there were too many roads.” Pavo examined his own shoes; Dema was already laughing.
pairs.hanzi:
“这不是让你们鉴定材料。”她说，“上一届跟岗的学生穿回来的。离开时说鞋够结实，回来时说路太多。”
帕沃低头看自己的鞋，德玛已经笑了。

pairs.target: lián xiū qián zuìhòu liǎngtiān , kè shàng wán , zhòngrén běnlái děng zhe fàng rén , wéi lǎoshī què ràng tāmen liúxià , tán xiàyìjiēduàn de qùchù .
pairs.english: Two days before the break, class ended and everyone expected dismissal, but Vey kept them to discuss where the next stage would take them.
pairs.hanzi: 连休前最后两天，课上完，众人本来等着放人，维老师却让他们留下，谈下一阶段的去处。

pairs.target: búshì nàzhǒng lǐng zhe quánbān qù bàntiān , wǎnshàng biàn huí sùshè de liànxí . xuégōng yào bǎ zhè yìpī dádào xiāngyìng yāoqiú de xuéshēng , sòngdào yǐ bìyè de cóngyèzhě shēnbiān , gēnzhe zuò shíliù zhōu de huó .
pairs.english: This wasn't a half-day class outing with everyone back in the dormitory that night. The academy would send students meeting the relevant requirements to work alongside graduates in their professions for sixteen weeks.
pairs.hanzi: 不是那种领着全班去半天、晚上便回宿舍的练习。学宫要把这一批达到相应要求的学生，送到已毕业的从业者身边，跟着做十六周的活。

pairs.target: yǒurén lìkè wèn shìbushì búyòng kǎo kè le . " yào jiāo jìlù , yào huílái fùchá . nǐ bú zài wǒ yǎnqián , bù děngyú wǒ kànbújiàn nǐ . "
pairs.english: Someone immediately asked whether that meant no more examinations. “You'll submit records and return for reviews. Out of my sight doesn't mean I can't see you.”
pairs.hanzi:
有人立刻问是不是不用考课了。
“要交记录，要回来复查。你不在我眼前，不等于我看不见你。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng xié wǎng pángbiān yì tuī , yòu shuō búshì bǎ rén àn běnshì dàxiǎo páichéng duì , zuì lìhài de sòng zuìyuǎn . yǒu de dìfāng quē huì suàn de rén , yǒu de shīfu yuànyì dài shǒumàn dàn kěn wèn de , qùchù dé liǎngbiān dōu kěn jiē .
pairs.english: Pushing the shoe aside, she said they wouldn't rank abilities and send the strongest farthest. Some places needed calculators, some supervisors would take slow hands willing to ask; both sides had to agree to the match.
pairs.hanzi: 她将鞋往旁边一推，又说不是把人按本事大小排成队，最厉害的送最远。有的地方缺会算的人，有的师傅愿意带手慢但肯问的，去处得两边都肯接。

pairs.target: chī zhù , gōngqián hé lùfèi huì xiān xiěmíng , búshì ràng xuéshēng zìjǐ bèizhe bāo qù qiú gè shuìjiào de jiǎoluò . tǎ wéi yuánběn bǎ zhǐ fàngjìn dài lǐ , yòu mànmàn ná le chūlái .
pairs.english: Food, lodging, wages and fares would be specified first; students wouldn't have to shoulder a bag and beg for a sleeping corner. Tavi slowly took out the paper he had put away.
pairs.hanzi:
吃住、工钱和路费会先写明，不是让学生自己背着包去求个睡觉的角落。
塔维原本把纸放进袋里，又慢慢拿了出来。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ qùshí zhuó shí , dào le dìsìtiān , hái huì xiǎngzhe huíxiào jiāowán dōngxī biàn hǎo . zhè yícì , shíliù zhōucháng dé xiàng yìtiáo cóng zhuōshàng yìzhí tuō dào ménwài de lù .
pairs.english: He remembered Stonewash: even on day four, he had been thinking of returning to school and handing things in. Sixteen weeks now seemed like a road trailing from the table all the way out the door.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起自己去石濯时，到了第四天，还会想着回校交完东西便好。这一次，十六周长得像一条从桌上一直拖到门外的路。

pairs.target: hòumén zhèshí jìnlái yìmíng shòugāo de nánrén , chuān duǎnguà , xiùkǒu juàn zhe , shǒushàng bào yíjuàn gāng mǎi de yóubù . tā shì wéi lǎoshī qǐnglái dáwèn de bìyèshēng , zài chéngwài gěi liángcāng xiū zhuāngxiè jià , gǎnzhe huíqù zhē yìpī pà yǔ de mùliào .
pairs.english: A tall thin man entered the back door, in a short jacket with rolled sleeves, carrying newly bought tarpaulin. The graduate Vey had invited for questions repaired grain-store loading frames outside the city and was rushing back to cover timber against rain.
pairs.hanzi: 后门这时进来一名瘦高的男人，穿短褂，袖口卷着，手上抱一卷刚买的油布。他是维老师请来答问的毕业生，在城外给粮仓修装卸架，赶着回去遮一批怕雨的木料。

pairs.target: yǒurén wèn tā huì buhuì zhěngtiān jiè xìng , tā xiào dé chàdiǎn bǎ yóubù diàoxiàqù . " nǐmen juéde wǒ shōu de shì měi huí shīshù de qián ? rénjiā yào de shì míngzǎo néng xiè liáng . xiàyǔ , wǒ xiān xiǎng zěnme bǎ mùtou gài shàng . "
pairs.english: Asked whether he borrowed properties all day, he laughed so hard he nearly dropped the tarpaulin. “You think I am paid per casting? They want grain unloaded tomorrow morning. If it rains, I first think how to cover the wood.”
pairs.hanzi:
有人问他会不会整天借性，他笑得差点把油布掉下去。
“你们觉得我收的是每回施术的钱？人家要的是明早能卸粮。下雨，我先想怎么把木头盖上。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ yóubù gē zài chuāng biān , shuō zìjǐ yǒushí yìtiān méi mō nà tào qìjù , yǒushí zuò wán yígè xiǎo kòujiàn biàn dé xiēshǒu , shèngxià de quán kào tóngbàn . tā shēnbiān gànhuó zuì lǎoliàn de rén bù cóng bái jiē bìyè , què néng tīng chēlún shēng zhīdào shuí yòu bǎ liángduī piān le .
pairs.english: Setting the tarpaulin by the window, he said some days he never touched his apparatus; others, one small clasp meant resting, with the rest left to colleagues. His most experienced coworker hadn't graduated from White Steps, but could hear from the wheels who'd loaded grain unevenly again.
pairs.hanzi: 他把油布搁在窗边，说自己有时一天没摸那套器具，有时做完一个小扣件便得歇手，剩下的全靠同伴。他身边干活最老练的人不从白阶毕业，却能听车轮声知道谁又把粮堆偏了。

pairs.target: dé mǎ wèn gēn gǎng de rén néng bunéng zhēn dòngshǒu , biéqùle zhī bāndōngxī . nánrén shuō dāngrán néng , dàn tóu yìtiān jiù xiǎng jiē zìjǐ bù dǒng de huó , zìjǐ huì bǎ rén sòng huílái .
pairs.english: Dema asked if placement students could really do things instead of only carrying. Of course, the man said, but anyone taking unfamiliar work on day one would be sent back.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛问跟岗的人能不能真动手，别去了只搬东西。男人说当然能，但头一天就想接自己不懂的活，自己会把人送回来。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé zhí , dé mǎ yě méi tuì , jìxù wèn tā shàng huí dài de xuéshēng dàodǐ xuéhuì le nǎ yíjiàn .
pairs.english: He was blunt. Dema didn't retreat, asking what exactly his previous student had learned.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得直，德玛也没退，继续问他上回带的学生到底学会了哪一件。

pairs.target: yúshì tā dūn zài jiǎngtái páng , yòng liǎngkuài mùbǎn bǎi chū zhuāngxiè jià de wèizhì , jiǎng nà rén zěnyàng bǎ chē dào bùliǎo de jiǎodù gǎi chūlái . tīngdào yíbàn , mǐlā jǐ dào qiántou , xián tā nà kuàibǎn bǎi wāi le . tā shuō dì běnlái jiù wāi , jiàoshì dì píng cái huàishì .
pairs.english: He crouched by the lectern and used two boards to show a loading frame, explaining how the student had altered an angle carts couldn't reach. Halfway through, Mira squeezed forward and objected to a crooked board. He said the ground was crooked; the flat classroom floor was the problem.
pairs.hanzi: 于是他蹲在讲台旁，用两块木板摆出装卸架的位置，讲那人怎样把车到不了的角度改出来。听到一半，米拉挤到前头，嫌他那块板摆歪了。他说地本来就歪，教室地平才坏事。

pairs.target: zhěngjiān wūzi xiào qǐlái . tǎ wéi què dīng zhe liǎngkuài mùbǎn , dìyīcì rènzhēn xiǎng , yuánlái zìjǐ kěyǐ qù zuò yíjiàn rìfùyírì dōu zài jìxù de huó , zhīdào zuótiān xiàyǔ hòu , jīntiān nǎ kuài dìfāng hái méi gān .
pairs.english: The whole room laughed. Tavi watched the boards, seriously considering for the first time work that continued day after day, knowing which patch still hadn't dried after yesterday's rain.
pairs.hanzi: 整间屋子笑起来。塔维却盯着两块木板，第一次认真想，原来自己可以去做一件日复一日都在继续的活，知道昨天下雨后，今天哪块地方还没干。

pairs.target: fàng rén qián , wéi lǎoshī ràng tāmen xiān xiě xiǎng kàn shénme , búbì jí zhe xiě xiǎng gēn shuí . huíxiào hòu zài tán pǐpèi , duǎn jiǎ zhào yuánlái de ānpái zǒu .
pairs.english: Before dismissal, Vey told them first to write what they wanted to see, without rushing to name a supervisor. Matching would follow their return; the short break kept its existing arrangements.
pairs.hanzi: 放人前，维老师让他们先写想看什么，不必急着写想跟谁。回校后再谈匹配，短假照原来的安排走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tèyì wèn qù yú wān de piào búyòng gǎi ba , tā shuō búyòng , bié bǎ liǎngjiànshì jiǎo chéng yì guō .
pairs.english: Tavi specifically asked whether his Elmbay ticket needed changing. No, she said; don't stir two matters into one pot.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维特意问去榆湾的票不用改吧，她说不用，别把两件事搅成一锅。

pairs.target: chūménshí , mǐlā shuō zìjǐ bùxiǎng zhī gēnzhe huàtú de rén , yào kàn yìzhāng tú zěnme zhēn biànchéng néng yòng de dōngxī . yīwén què zài xiǎng , rúguǒ liǎnggè dìfāng dōu shuō mǒu duàn lù guī zìjǐ , gēn shuí gànhuó de rén shuōlesuàn .
pairs.english: Outside, Mira said she didn't want only to follow a draftsman; she wanted to see a drawing become something usable. Iven wondered who had the say when two places both claimed the same stretch of road.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，米拉说自己不想只跟着画图的人，要看一张图怎么真变成能用的东西。伊文却在想，如果两个地方都说某段路归自己，跟谁干活的人说了算。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō tā xiǎng zhīdào nǎgè qùchù yǒu bú lòufēng de chuáng . " nǐ xiě shàng . " yīwén shuō , " shuōbúdìng bǐ wǒmen de dōu zǎo dìng . "
pairs.english: Pavo wanted to know which place had a bed without drafts. “Write it down,” Iven said. “Yours might be settled sooner than ours.”
pairs.hanzi:
帕沃说他想知道哪个去处有不漏风的床。
“你写上。”伊文说，“说不定比我们的都早定。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu lìkè xiě . tā zǒu dào táijiē xià , huítóu kànjiàn shòugāo nánrén bào zhe yóubù pǎo chūlái , xiégēn qiāo dé hěn xiǎng . wéi lǎoshī zài hòumiàn zhuī zhe hǎn , jiào tā bǎ zìjǐ nà zhī jiù xiédài zǒu , bié yòu liúgěi tā .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't write immediately. Below the steps he looked back and saw the thin man run out with his tarpaulin, heels clattering. Vey called after him to take his old shoe, not leave it with her again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有立刻写。他走到台阶下，回头看见瘦高男人抱着油布跑出来，鞋跟敲得很响。维老师在后面追着喊，叫他把自己那只旧鞋带走，别又留给她。

pairs.target: nánrén zhīdé zhéfǎn , yìshǒu bào yóubù , yìshǒu līn xié , xiàng gāng bèi lǎoshī gǎn chūmén de xuéshēng .
pairs.english: The man had to turn back, tarpaulin in one hand and shoe in the other, like a student just dismissed by his teacher.
pairs.hanzi: 男人只得折返，一手抱油布，一手拎鞋，像刚被老师赶出门的学生。
